text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r l-a-u-n-c-h-e-d a-c-c-e-s-s at-t-e-m-p-t-s on c-u-s-t-o-m-e-r a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s and left a c-o-v-e-r t-r-a-c-e of l-o-g-i-n a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y in t-h-e a-u-d-i-t r-e-c-o-r-d while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-a-c-t-i-o-n t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d c-h-e-c-k
2) the a-c-t-o-r m-o-v-e-d g-i-f-t b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s to e-x-t-e-r-n-a-l p-a-r-t-y-s and left a t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r j-o-u-r-n-a-l in t-h-e s-e-t-t-l-e-m-e-n-t l-e-d-g-e-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-r-a-u-d s-c-o-r-e r-e-v-i-e-w
3) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-v-e-r-t-e-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s to c-a-s-h or g-o-o-d-s and left a r-e-d-e-e-m-p-t-i-o-n r-e-c-e-i-p-t in t-h-e p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e h-i-s-t-o-r-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-e-l-o-c-i-t-y t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d c-h-e-c-k
4) the a-c-t-o-r m-i-m-i-c-k-e-d n-o-r-m-a-l b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r on the p-l-a-t-f-o-r-m and left a s-e-s-s-i-o-n p-a-t-t-e-r-n in t-h-e a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y l-o-g-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r-b-a-s-e-l-i-n-e c-h-e-c-k
5) the a-c-t-o-r r-i-n-g e-m-u-l-a-t-e-d a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s to a-v-o-i-d d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n and left a t-r-a-f-f-i-c m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a in t-h-e d-e-v-i-c-e l-o-g-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-e-v-i-c-e f-p-r-i-n-t c-h-e-c-k
